threat_event: Ransomware spreads from the business network into OT at one or both plants, encrypting SCADA, historians, the MES, and HMIs and halting processing lines and cold-chain monitoring
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plant 2 flat network; Plant 2 remote access without MFA; OT backups not offline or immutable; no OT monitoring by the MSSP; 9 HMIs on unsupported operating systems
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 to SYS-06; BP-01 to BP-10
existing_controls: MFA for workforce accounts; EDR and 24x7 MSSP on IT; Plant 1 OT DMZ; immutable cloud backups
treatment_plan: Segment Plant 2 with an OT DMZ; move Plant 2 vendors to the gateway; immutable OT backups and restore tests; OT alerts to the MSSP; plant ransomware tabletop 2026-11-19
exposure_estimate_usd: $3M-$7M (lost output, held product, response; insurance limit $15M)

threat_event: Attacker uses the Plant 2 integrator's shared, always-on VPN account (no MFA) to reach SCADA, blenders, and the label server
threat_source: Cybercriminal or hacktivist using stolen integrator credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared VPN account never expires, no MFA, no session logging; flat Plant 2 network
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02; SYS-03; SYS-06; SYS-14; BP-07; BP-08
existing_controls: VPN disabled outside supervised sessions since 2026-09-15 (interim condition)
treatment_plan: Move the Plant 2 integrator onto the remote access gateway with named accounts, MFA, approval, and recording; retire the VPN account

threat_event: Unauthorized or malicious change to cure and brine dosing, injector rates, smokehouse cycles, or chill targets through shared HMI or MES logins leads to adulterated product being shipped
threat_source: Insider (disgruntled employee or temporary) or attacker with OT access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared operator logins; HMI setpoint edits not attributed or approved; no alerting on setpoint changes; no hardwired dosing limits on Injector 2
existing_controls: Plant 1 MES formulation releases need two approvals; locked dosing skid room; CCTV
treatment_plan: Named HMI and MES accounts; two-person approval for setpoint changes; range limits in HMIs; setpoint change alerts to FSQA; daily formulation comparison with the signed master

threat_event: Plant 2 blend recipes or fat targets are changed without approval, producing misbranded lean claims or wrong blends
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Blend recipes stored only in HMIs; one maintenance password; no second approval; 23 of 41 Plant 2 change records unapproved
existing_controls: QA lab fat tests each shift
treatment_plan: Move blend recipes into a controlled recipe store with approval; change control at Plant 2; QA verification of every recipe change

threat_event: Attacker uses the always-on cellular modem on the Plant 2 refrigeration controller to change setpoints or disable alarms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on modem with vendor-managed credentials; no MFA; never reviewed under PSM management of change
existing_controls: Hardwired ammonia detectors and local alarms; engine room staffed
treatment_plan: Disconnect the modem; refrigeration contractor onto the gateway; PSM management of change review of the remote access path

threat_event: Electronic CCP and Sanitation SOP records cannot be shown to be complete, attributable, and unaltered when FSIS reviews them or after an incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plant 2 historian audit trail disabled; typed initials as signatures; shared records administrator; Plant 2 clock drift up to 6 minutes
existing_controls: Plant 1 historian audit trail; records application audit log
treatment_plan: Enable the Plant 2 audit trail; named accounts and authenticated sign-off; record locking after pre-shipment review; time synchronization; STD-05 records integrity standard
owner: Vice President of Food Safety and Quality Assurance

threat_event: Plant 1 SCADA and MES cannot be restored within their 4- to 8-hour RTOs after an attack or failure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT backup server is not offline or immutable; only SCADA restore-tested (2025); PLC repository covers about 75% of PLCs
existing_controls: Nightly OT backups; signed paper formulation masters
treatment_plan: Immutable offline OT backup copies; complete the PLC repository; quarterly restore tests in the sanitation window

threat_event: Plant 2 PLC programs, blend recipes, or the label server cannot be restored after a failure or attack
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PLC programs and recipes only on integrator laptops; label server not backed up
existing_controls: Integrator holds copies
treatment_plan: Company-owned PLC and recipe repository for Plant 2; label server backups; restore test

threat_event: An attack in OT goes undetected long enough to change processes or spread, because OT is not monitored by the MSSP
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plant 1 passive sensor alerts reviewed weekly on a local console; no OT logs in the SIEM; no monitoring at Plant 2
existing_controls: Passive sensor at Plant 1; EDR on IT
treatment_plan: Send sensor alerts and OT logs to the MSSP; deploy a sensor at Plant 2; OT use cases (setpoint change, new device, engineering download)

threat_event: Attacker exploits an unsupported operating system on an HMI or engineering workstation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 HMIs and 2 engineering workstations on unsupported operating systems; no allowlisting
existing_controls: Plant 1 HMIs behind the OT DMZ
treatment_plan: Replace in the 2027 capital plan; allowlisting and port restrictions in the meantime

threat_event: An unknown or forgotten OT device is exploited or missed during response
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT inventory about 75% at Plant 1, none at Plant 2
existing_controls: Passive discovery at Plant 1
treatment_plan: Passive discovery at Plant 2; reconcile inventories quarterly

threat_event: Plant 2 cold-chain monitoring fails without anyone noticing, and product is temperature-abused
threat_source: Gateway or Wi-Fi failure; missed SMS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One SMS recipient, no escalation; gateways on office Wi-Fi; no manual log procedure
existing_controls: Refrigeration runs locally; supervisor on call
treatment_plan: Three-role escalation by app and phone; gateways on a dedicated network with cellular backup; manual log procedure and drill
owner: Director of Supply Chain and Logistics

threat_event: Cold-chain SaaS outage longer than 2 hours at Plant 1
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single vendor; no SOC 2 report; gateways buffer only 24 hours
existing_controls: Written Plant 1 manual log procedure; local buffering
treatment_plan: Vendor availability commitments in the contract; local gateway alarm outputs to the engine room panel
owner: Director of Supply Chain and Logistics

threat_event: During a cyber incident, refrigeration is operated without supervisory visibility and an ammonia release follows
threat_source: Cyber incident combined with operator error
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PSM emergency plans do not address loss of supervisory control; no manual operation drill
existing_controls: Hardwired detection and alarms; staffed engine rooms
treatment_plan: Add cyber scenarios to the PSM and RMP emergency plans; manual operation drill at each plant

threat_event: Adulterated or misbranded product ships during a control-system incident because cyber response is not tied to product hold and FSIS notification
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: IR plan (2024) is IT-only; no product hold step; no 418.2 decision point
existing_controls: HACCP corrective action procedures; recall procedure
treatment_plan: P08 runbooks with product hold and notification decisions; tabletop with FSQA and plant managers
owner: Vice President of Food Safety and Quality Assurance

threat_event: The 24-hour FSIS notice is late or incomplete because lot tracing is unavailable during an incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Traceability database never restore-tested; offline export not yet in place
existing_controls: Daily cloud backups; ERP shipment history
treatment_plan: Daily controlled offline traceability export; restore test of the traceability database
owner: Vice President of Food Safety and Quality Assurance

threat_event: Adversary-in-the-middle phishing bypasses push MFA and takes over an office or supervisor account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA for non-administrators; phishing click rate 9.4%
existing_controls: Number matching; conditional access; MSSP impossible-travel alerts
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for finance, FSQA approvers, and IT; targeted training

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects a supplier, carrier, or payroll payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank detail changes accepted by email at Plant 2
existing_controls: Call-back rule at corporate
treatment_plan: Extend the call-back rule to Plant 2; ERP vendor bank change workflow with two approvals

threat_event: Privileged account on a SaaS administrator console or an OT engineering account is taken over and used to disable defenses or change processes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Privileged access management only for cloud and domain administrators; 47 OT privileged accounts without MFA
existing_controls: Cloud just-in-time elevation; MFA for IdP administrators
treatment_plan: Privileged access management for SaaS and OT administrators; MFA on engineering workstations

threat_event: A former employee or contractor keeps access, because reviews are annual and shared OT passwords do not change
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Annual reviews; 4 of 25 late terminations; shared OT passwords unchanged after departures
existing_controls: HR-driven deprovisioning for identity provider accounts
treatment_plan: Quarterly reviews; rotate shared OT passwords at each departure until named accounts are live

threat_event: Stale or unknown privileged accounts in the prior owner's Plant 2 directory are used by an attacker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Prior owner's directory still runs Plant 2 OT logins and file shares; 9 accounts with unknown owners
existing_controls: None beyond the Plant 2 firewall
treatment_plan: Disable unknown accounts now; migrate Plant 2 to the company directory and identity provider; retire the old directory

threat_event: A future acquisition connects to company networks with unknown weaknesses, as Plant 2 did
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security due diligence or integration standard for acquisitions
existing_controls: Ad hoc review of Plant 2 after closing
treatment_plan: Security due diligence checklist and a quarantine-first integration standard approved by the board

threat_event: Compromise of the Plant 1 controls integrator reaches SCADA or the MES through its always-enabled gateway account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 vendor accounts on the gateway stay enabled between sessions; no security terms in contracts
existing_controls: Gateway MFA and session recording
treatment_plan: Per-session enablement with approval; security and incident notice terms in OT vendor contracts

threat_event: The cold-chain monitoring vendor is breached, or its alert configuration is changed, and temperature excursions are missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No SOC 2 report; no security or notice terms; vendor administrators can edit alert rules
existing_controls: Local gateway buffering
treatment_plan: Obtain a SOC 2 Type 2 or equivalent; add security and notice terms; monthly alert rule review
owner: Director of Supply Chain and Logistics

threat_event: The AI vision vendor pushes a model update or uses remote access on the Lines 5-7 edge servers outside change control
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor remote tool always on; two model updates in 2026 without notice
existing_controls: x-ray CCP unchanged and independent of AI-001
treatment_plan: Vendor access through the gateway; model updates as OT changes with re-validation (P10)

threat_event: Staff come to rely on AI vision inspection and reduce manual checks; the system misses foreign material on a product type it handles poorly
threat_source: AI model error with automation bias
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AI-001 relationship to the x-ray CCP undefined; no subgroup performance monitoring before P10
existing_controls: x-ray and metal detection CCP unchanged
treatment_plan: Conditions in P10: AI-001 supplemental only; subgroup monitoring; reassessment before any change to inspection staffing
owner: Vice President of Food Safety and Quality Assurance

threat_event: Demand forecasting errors drive overproduction of short-shelf-life product or shortfalls on promotions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Forecast accuracy not monitored after the 2026 model change
existing_controls: Planner review of forecasts
treatment_plan: Monthly forecast accuracy report and planner override log (P10)

threat_event: Staff paste formulations, food defense content, or employee data into public generative AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No AI policy before P06; public tools reachable from the network
existing_controls: None before 2026-10
treatment_plan: POL-05 AI rules; enterprise assistant with data-use terms (AI-004); web filtering of unapproved tools

threat_event: The HR SaaS applicant ranking feature disadvantages applicants by a protected characteristic
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feature enabled by vendor default in 2026-04 without review
existing_controls: Recruiters see all applicants
treatment_plan: Feature disabled 2026-08-20 pending review; vendor bias testing evidence required before any use (P10)

threat_event: The refrigeration predictive maintenance vendor's data feed becomes an inbound path to the controllers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Outbound telemetry from the Plant 1 OT DMZ broker; vendor has no inbound access today
existing_controls: One-way outbound telemetry through the broker
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low: telemetry is one-way and reviewed under PSM management of change; recheck at contract renewal

threat_event: An insider routes CIP chemicals into the Plant 1 brine system through HMI valve controls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Injector 2 brine system has no hardwired interlock against CIP valves in production mode (Injector 1 has one); shared logins
existing_controls: Locked dosing skid room; CCTV; Injector 1 interlock
treatment_plan: Hardwired interlock on Injector 2; valve state alarms to FSQA; food defense reassessment

threat_event: Formulations and trade secrets are stolen through the open Plant 2 share or by an insider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plant 2 share open to all office staff; no data loss controls
existing_controls: Plant 1 FSQA library restricted
treatment_plan: Move Plant 2 formulation masters to the restricted FSQA library; classification labels (POL-04)
owner: Vice President of Food Safety and Quality Assurance

threat_event: The food defense plans are exposed, giving an attacker a map of vulnerable steps
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plant 2 plan on the open share
existing_controls: Plant 1 plan in the restricted library
treatment_plan: Move the Plant 2 plan; access list reviewed by the VP FSQA each quarter
owner: Vice President of Food Safety and Quality Assurance

threat_event: Employee personal information (Social Security numbers, bank accounts) is breached through the HR SaaS, file shares, or email
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payroll exports emailed between HR and finance; Plant 2 HR files on the open share
existing_controls: MFA; EDR; HR SaaS SOC 2
treatment_plan: Stop emailed payroll exports; move Plant 2 HR files; data loss rules in the productivity suite

threat_event: A breach notice deadline is missed (Florida 30 days; other states for Plant 2 employees living in Georgia)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No breach decision log before P08
existing_controls: Outside counsel through the insurer
treatment_plan: Decision log and notification matrix in P08

threat_event: The customer traceability portal is compromised, exposing customer data or altering lot data and certificates of analysis
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Portal MFA optional for customer users until 2026-06; processing integrity checks informal
existing_controls: Managed edge; TLS; MFA enforced since 2026-06
treatment_plan: Integrity checks on certificates of analysis; change logs reviewed; SOC 2 readiness work (P09)
owner: Vice President of Sales and Customer Service

threat_event: EDI gateway outage stops orders and advance ship notices for more than a day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single gateway; restore not tested
existing_controls: Provider-managed platform; email order fallback
treatment_plan: Restore test and documented failover to the EDI network provider's web portal

threat_event: The SOC 2 Type 2 report is not ready by 2027-12-31 and the largest customer reduces volume
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Readiness gaps in P09; observation period must start by 2027-04-01
existing_controls: vCISO-led readiness plan
treatment_plan: Remediate Not ready criteria by 2027-03-31; start the observation period 2027-04-01 (P09)

threat_event: Cloud storage or a database is exposed to the internet by misconfiguration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Guardrails cover common cases; no review of the data warehouse sharing settings
existing_controls: Organization guardrails; posture service
treatment_plan: Monthly posture review with the MSSP; data warehouse sharing review

threat_event: Backups in the backup account are deleted or encrypted
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Separate account, write-once retention, separate credentials
existing_controls: Write-once vault; cross-account write-only role
treatment_plan: Accepted at Moderate by the COO: within appetite because backups are isolated and write-once; reviewed every 6 months

threat_event: A known-exploited vulnerability in an internet-facing firewall, VPN, or the remote access gateway is exploited before it is patched
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Gateway patched in 9 days for the last known-exploited vulnerability; Plant 2 firewall firmware a year old
existing_controls: Monthly scans; CISA KEV tracking
treatment_plan: 72-hour target for known-exploited vulnerabilities on internet-facing devices (STD-08); Plant 2 firewall replacement

threat_event: Identity provider outage blocks access to SaaS and the records application
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Break-glass accounts exist only for the cloud
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2; paper records workaround
treatment_plan: Break-glass accounts for the records application and ERP

threat_event: A hurricane cuts power and communications at one or both plants for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plant 2 single ISP; fuel for 72 hours
existing_controls: Generators; fuel contracts; manual logs at Plant 1
treatment_plan: Cellular failover at Plant 2; fuel priority agreement; hurricane checklist covering OT shutdown and restart

threat_event: A Plant 2 ISP outage cuts the cold-chain dashboard, ERP, and WMS for a day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single ISP at Plant 2
existing_controls: Gateway local buffering
treatment_plan: Cellular failover (due 2026-12-31)

threat_event: An investigation cannot scope an OT incident because logs are missing or have expired
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT logs; plant firewall and gateway logs kept 30 to 90 days
existing_controls: SIEM keeps IT logs 1 year
treatment_plan: Forward plant firewall and gateway logs to the SIEM; 1-year retention (STD-04)

threat_event: A production or sanitation worker plugs in a USB drive or falls for a social engineering call, introducing malware to OT
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security awareness for production, sanitation, maintenance, or temporaries; USB open on HMIs
existing_controls: Food defense awareness at orientation
treatment_plan: Short security module in orientation and annual food defense refresher; USB blocking on HMIs

threat_event: An intruder or unauthorized worker reaches the Plant 2 OT server closet or engine room panel and tampers with equipment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plant 2 OT closet and engine room panel unlocked; contractors unescorted
existing_controls: Plant perimeter badge access
treatment_plan: Badge locks on the OT closet and engine room panel; escort rule for contractors

threat_event: Configuration drift weakens OT hosts because no OT settings standard exists
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT baselines; STD-01 in draft
existing_controls: Plant 1 server baselines
treatment_plan: Issue STD-01 with OT baselines; quarterly drift checks

threat_event: Denial of service against the customer portal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public portal
existing_controls: Provider edge protection; rate limits
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low: provider edge protection and email fallback
owner: Vice President of Sales and Customer Service

threat_event: A laptop holding formulation copies or records exports is lost or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Full-disk encryption on all laptops
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; remote wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low: encrypted devices with remote wipe

threat_event: Response to an OT incident is uncoordinated because the plans have never been exercised with plant leadership
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT playbook before P08; no plant tabletop
existing_controls: MSSP and insurer panel for IT incidents
treatment_plan: Plant tabletops 2026-11-19 (ransomware) and 2027-02-18 (tampering)

threat_event: Attacker or insider uses the manufacturer default administrator password on the Plant 1 Line 6 x-ray unit to change reject sensitivity, letting foreign material pass the CCP (found in P07)
threat_source: Insider or attacker with OT network access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default password on the x-ray web service (changed 2026-08-09); no check of other inspection devices; web service reachable from the Line 6 HMI network
existing_controls: Password changed 2026-08-09; daily test-piece checks of the x-ray unit
treatment_plan: Check all inspection devices for default credentials; disable unneeded web services; add credential checks to commissioning
